description: 意大利开局 C54 — 轻子出完立即易位，时机判断

intro.popup_en: Castling, Lesson 1: When should you castle? Once the minor pieces are developed, castle promptly. Every delay gives the opponent another opportunity.
intro.popup:
王车易位第1课
何时易位？
轻子全部出动后，立即易位！
每拖一步，都是给对手的机会

outro.popup_en: A useful rhythm is: develop the minor pieces, then castle. The king gains shelter behind the pawn shield, and castling connects and activates the rooks. Do not spend extra tempi while your king remains in the center.
outro.popup:
易位时机总结
✅ 轻子出完 → 立即易位
✅ 易位后王藏在兵盾后
✅ 车立刻连通，准备参战
不要贪图一步棋而延误易位！

moves.popup_en: e4 occupies the center and begins the Italian Game.
moves.popup:
e4占中心
意大利开局开始

moves.popup_en: ...e5 mirrors White's central advance.
moves.popup:
e5对称
中心对峙

moves.popup_en: Nf3 develops and attacks e5, completing White's first minor-piece development move.
moves.popup:
Nf3发展马
攻击e5，轻子第1步

moves.popup_en: ...Nc6 develops and protects e5, completing Black's first minor piece.
moves.popup:
Nc6保护e5
黑方轻子第1步

moves.popup_en: Bc4 develops the Italian bishop and targets f7, completing White's second minor piece.
moves.popup:
Bc4意大利象
瞄准f7弱格
轻子第2步

moves.popup_en: ...Bc5 mirrors White's development and completes Black's second minor piece.
moves.popup:
Bc5对称
黑方轻子第2步

moves.popup_en: c3 prepares d4 and makes a steady central advance.
moves.popup:
c3为d4做准备
稳健推进

moves.popup_en: ...Nf6 develops Black's third minor piece and prepares castling.
moves.popup:
Nf6发展
黑方轻子第3步
准备易位！

moves.popup_en: d3 supports the center in the closed Italian setup. White continues to develop steadily.
moves.popup:
d3稳固中心
意大利封闭体系
白方稳步布局

moves.popup_en: ...d6 stabilizes Black's center while development continues.
moves.popup:
d6稳固
黑方继续发展

moves.popup_en: Nbd2 develops White's final minor piece. White's pieces are ready, so the conditions for castling are met.
moves.popup:
Nbd2发展马
白方轻子全部出动
此刻具备易位条件！

moves.popup_en: ...O-O! Black castles as soon as the minor pieces are developed. The king reaches g8 behind its pawn shield and the rook becomes active on f8.
moves.popup:
O-O！黑方率先易位
轻子出完立即易位
王藏在g8，f8车激活

moves.popup_en: O-O! White follows promptly. The king is safe on g1, the rook reaches f1, and the rooks are connected and ready to work.
moves.popup:
O-O！白方跟进易位
王到g1，安全！
注意：f1车现在可以立刻移动了
双车已连通

moves.popup_en: ...Re8! Black activates a rook immediately after castling and occupies the e-file.
moves.popup:
Re8！
易位后立刻激活车
黑车占领e线

moves.popup_en: Re1! White also activates a rook on the e-file, contesting Black's rook.
moves.popup:
Re1！
白车也立刻激活
占领e线与黑车对峙

moves.popup_en: ...Bb6 retreats the bishop from the pressure and adjusts Black's setup.
moves.popup:
Bb6象撤退
避开攻击，调整阵型

moves.popup_en: Nf1 reroutes the knight toward g3 and f5, seeking a useful outpost.
moves.popup:
Nf1马重新部署
准备Ng3-f5强占好格

moves.popup_en: ...Ne7 reroutes Black's knight for a new role.
moves.popup:
Ne7马调整
黑方重新部署

moves.popup_en: Ng3 places the knight actively, controlling f5 and h5.
moves.popup:
Ng3马到好位
控制f5和h5

moves.popup_en: ...c6 reinforces Black's position.
moves.popup:
c6稳固
黑方巩固

moves.popup_en: h3 prevents ...Bg4 from pinning White's knight.
moves.popup:
h3备手
防止Bg4牵制

moves.popup_en: ...Ng6 develops the knight to an active square.
moves.popup:
Ng6马活跃
黑方出子

moves.popup_en: d4! Both sides have castled, so White can safely advance in the center. Without king safety, opening the center could expose the king still on e1.
moves.popup:
d4！推进中心
双方均已易位完毕
才有资格推进中心
若无易位，d4推进暴露中路国王！
